name: Hubbub the Stubby Tabby Cat
blurb: Hubbub, a short-legged brown tabby with a cream bib and white toe tips, trots between the garden benches to hear every lively chat.

name: Socklet the Short-Legged Cat
blurb: Socklet, a round, stubby-legged brown tabby with a pale chin and four white-tipped toes, pads along the garden path in tiny, busy steps.

name: Natter the Low-Slung Tabby Cat
blurb: Natter, a plump brown tabby on short legs with a cream bib and olive eyes, naps by the garden notice board where all the chatter gets pinned.
